state.role_invariant: One tenant and role identity has one active or deleted lifecycle, normalized name, immutable creation identity, and built-in protection.
state.team_invariant: One tenant and team identity has one active or deleted lifecycle, immutable creation identity, and built-in protection.
state.membership_invariant: One tenant/team/member relationship has at most one active assignment bound to a nonempty membership episode.

role_identity.instructions: Does the role require its own identity for normal creation while preserving the special built-in migration?

criteria.true: Normal definition uses RoleId and the alternate rename-based creation is limited to built-in roles.
criteria.false: A custom role can be created through a different identity or an unrelated rename.

role_replay.instructions: Does role replay reject a foreign definition and deletion of a built-in role?

criteria.true: Both foreign definitions and built-in deletions are rejected before applying state.
criteria.false: Either invalid fact can be applied.

team_replay.instructions: Does team replay reject a foreign definition and deletion of a built-in team?

criteria.true: Both foreign definitions and built-in deletions are rejected before applying state.
criteria.false: Either invalid fact can be applied.

membership_replay.instructions: Does team membership replay reject an assignment with no membership episode?

criteria.true: The assignment must carry a nonempty membership episode.

coverage.instructions: Do the supplied tests exercise rejection of an empty membership episode during team membership replay?

criteria.true: A test replays a team membership assignment with an empty episode and asserts rejection.
criteria.false: No test replays an empty team membership episode and asserts rejection.
